purpose: Research planning inventory for independently supported non-event observations. This file contains no candidate observations and no invented labels.
project_status: SAMPLING PLAN READY — OBSERVATIONS NOT YET VERIFIED

sources.name: Landslide inventory for the 2018 storm event of Kodagu in the Western Ghats
sources.temporal_coverage: 2018 storm-event inventory; no record-level dates in acquired attributes
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY-SA 4.0 as recorded in the acquisition report
sources.evidence_scope: Recorded landslide presence only; absence from the files is not evidence of a non-event.
limitations: Point Name identifiers repeat and require source-row identity.
Point and polygon inventories have no source-backed event crosswalk.
Coverage and reporting completeness are not established.

sources.name: Kerala 2018 monsoon landslide inventory
sources.publisher: DANS Data Station / C.J. van Westen
sources.temporal_coverage: 2018 monsoon inventory; no record-level dates in acquired attributes
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 as recorded in the acquisition report
sources.evidence_scope: Mapped landslide presence only; unlisted locations have unknown status.
limitations: No explicit stable-ground or non-landslide class.
No complete observation footprint or reporting-completeness field.
No record-level occurrence date.

sources.name: NRSC/NDEM disaster documentation
sources.geographic_coverage: Karnataka disaster-document example; coverage depends on individual document
sources.license_or_terms: Reuse and redistribution terms require confirmation from NRSC
sources.evidence_scope: Can provide mapped disaster context or incident evidence. It does not automatically document adequate search coverage for negatives.
limitations: A disaster map is not a complete non-event survey.
A negative label would require explicit coverage, resolution, observation date and review evidence.

sources.name: Bhuvan data products and catalog
sources.temporal_coverage: Product-specific; the accessed catalog lists product periods and resolutions
sources.license_or_terms: Product-specific; confirm terms before download or redistribution
sources.evidence_scope: Potential imagery/DEM source for a documented review, not a ready-made negative-label dataset.
limitations: Catalog metadata alone does not establish stable ground.
Historical image review still needs a defined footprint, date window, quality assessment and reviewer.

sources.name: Landsat data archive
sources.temporal_coverage: Multi-decadal archive; scene and sensor dependent
sources.license_or_terms: USGS/NASA data-use terms apply; verify product-specific attribution
sources.evidence_scope: Suitable source for human-reviewed pre/post imagery evidence over an explicitly documented area and period.
limitations: Medium-resolution imagery can miss small or obscured failures.
No visible change is not proof of no landslide without adequate image quality and reviewer criteria.
Clouds, shadows, vegetation and revisit gaps create false-negative risk.

sources.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem Sentinel collections
sources.temporal_coverage: Mission/product dependent; Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 provide date-stamped acquisitions
sources.license_or_terms: Copernicus data policy and product-specific terms apply
sources.evidence_scope: Potential source for a repeatable image-review protocol; not a labeled non-event collection.
limitations: Sentinel-1 backscatter or raw GRD is not itself a landslide or stable-ground label.
A negative interpretation needs a documented baseline, post-event image, processing method and reviewer.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata Search
sources.license_or_terms: Product-specific provider terms and attribution apply
sources.evidence_scope: Discovery and access route for time-stamped imagery and environmental products used in a review.
limitations: Search availability does not prove a location was observed cloud-free.
Products must be checked for spatial support, temporal alignment and quality flags.

sources.name: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority
sources.license_or_terms: Confirm report-specific reuse and attribution terms
sources.evidence_scope: Potential source of official incident reports and response coverage. Reports are not presumed complete negative surveys.
limitations: Non-reporting can reflect access, awareness or reporting bias.
A negative observation requires explicit statement of search coverage and observation period.

sources.name: Prospective field survey with documented search coverage
sources.publisher: To be commissioned with a qualified survey team
sources.temporal_coverage: Survey date and retrospective lookback must be specified
sources.license_or_terms: Requires project-specific consent, safety, data-use and attribution terms
sources.evidence_scope: Strongest local evidence when the survey footprint, search protocol, observation date, reviewer and uncertainty are recorded.
limitations: A survey supports only its searched area and observation period.
Access, safety and observer detection limits remain possible sources of false negatives.

current_conclusion.next_concrete_action: Select a bounded Kodagu or Kerala pilot frame, acquire cloud-screened pre/post imagery or conduct a documented field survey, and have two reviewers complete the proposed review schema before any label is admitted.
